name: Rembrandt
findings: Uses smoky black 3.3x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 875 paintings here).
Uses black 3.1x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 875 paintings here).
Uses raisin black 3.0x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 875 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, navy turns up as a small accent in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 3.9x the archive's rate (from 875 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, zinc grey turns up as the lightest note in 54% of the paintings that hold it, 3.9x the archive's rate (from 875 paintings here).
Pairs dark purple with purple violet more than chance would predict (3 of 875 paintings here).
Pairs dim grey with greyish black more than chance would predict (3 of 875 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, black, raisin black) covers 67% of his paintings here.
